title: Each corner of a shape can be rounded on its own
goal: Corner Radius rounds all four corners of a shape by the same amount, and there is no way to round only some of them. A card with a rounded top and a square bottom, a segmented control whose two ends are round and whose middle is square, a speech bubble: none of them can be drawn without faking it with a second shape on top. Let a person open the one number into four and set each corner.
notes:
CAPABILITY GAP. Sources/PhotonzCore/CornerRadiusSelection.swift carries one radius per layer, and the panel draws it as a single slider (visible in queue/manager/shots/2026-09-08-2215-versions.png, Appearance, Corner Radius 18 pt). Nothing in PhotonzCore models a per corner radius.

This finishes a control the user already uses rather than adding a new surface, so it needs no decision card. What DOES need care is that it must not cost the common case: the single number stays the default face and opening it into four is a deliberate act, the same shape as GroupPadding in Sources/PhotonzCore/GroupLayout.swift, which is one number that opens into four sides. Copy that model, its Codable behaviour and its panel treatment rather than inventing a second idiom.

Everything that reads the radius has to follow: the fill, the ring (Sources/PhotonzCore/RingShape.swift), the selection outline (SelectionOutlineShape.swift, which learned to follow a rounded shape on 2026-09-08), and clipping. Sources/PhotonzCore/CornerRadiusSelection.swift already knows which layers have corners at all, so the row keeps hiding itself where there are none.

Flag: next-shape-parts (FeatureCatalog.shapePartsFlag), on by default in Next.
acceptance: A shape with corners can be given a different radius on each of its four corners, and the one number is still the way in: nobody who wants all four the same has to type four numbers
The shape, its border, its selection outline and anything it clips all follow the four numbers, not just the fill
A document saved with four different corners opens with them, and a document saved before this opens unchanged
Try it: Experiments window, Next release, Appearance is what it is Effects is what you add is on by default. Draw a rectangle, open Corner Radius into its four corners, and round the top two only
An audit is written under queue/audits/ with a real window capture, and anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task
